title: Add Icon
description: Adds an icon to the SSR offline subset via the dynamic icon manifest and regenerates it

project.description: Target project name (required in multiproject workspaces)
project.x-prompt: Which project should receive the icon?

icon.description: Icon to add in prefix:name format. Repeatable: --icon mdi:home --icon mdi:user (Angular CLI) or comma-separated: --icon mdi:home,mdi:user (Nx)
icon.x-prompt: Which icon should be added to the subset? (prefix:name, e.g. mdi:home)
